summary: Before importing, stop every containerized service except the database with `systemctl --user stop`: `pcp` if configured; controller `automation-controller-task`, `-web`, `-rsyslog` and `receptor`; hub `automation-hub-api`, `-content`, `-web`, `-worker-1/2`; EDA scheduler, daphne, web, api, workers and activation workers; gateway `automation-gateway` and `-proxy`; and `redis-unix redis-tcp` on the gateway or Redis nodes.
questions: How do I stop containerized AAP services?
Which systemd user services does containerized AAP run?
How do I stop Redis in containerized AAP?
Stop AAP services before database restore

answer_card.title: Stop containerized services (not the DB)
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
systemctl --user stop pcp   # if configured
systemctl --user stop automation-controller-task automation-controller-web automation-controller-rsyslog receptor
systemctl --user stop automation-hub-api automation-hub-content automation-hub-web automation-hub-worker-1 automation-hub-worker-2
systemctl --user stop automation-eda-scheduler automation-eda-daphne automation-eda-web automation-eda-api \
  automation-eda-worker-1 automation-eda-worker-2 automation-eda-activation-worker-1 automation-eda-activation-worker-2
systemctl --user stop automation-gateway automation-gateway-proxy
systemctl --user stop redis-unix redis-tcp   # gateway node, or every Redis node
```
Run each on its component node.
